title: An intrinsically subcritical four-point counterexample
summary: Building on the vector-Zak and cohomological framework developed by Faulhuber, Petersen, van Velthoven, and Voigtlaender in their twelve-point counterexample, we give a computer-assisted four-point counterexample with a nonzero complex-valued Schwartz window. Every symplectic triangle determinant of the explicit configuration has absolute value below one, placing it in the intrinsically subcritical regime.
